reason: The named lab and the per-batch report would normally win me over, and at $24.99 the launch box works out to about 83 cents a day, which I can live with. I would try one box, not two, and only because the empty-box guarantee means I am not stuck with another half-used bottle in the drawer.
objection: A foil sachet every day is a lot of packaging waste for 30 days, and I still have a drawer full of supplements I stopped taking. I worry I will quit by day 10 like the last ones.
would_change_my_mind: A lower price per day, like two boxes for around $40, or a TikTok Shop flash sale or coupon, would make me buy two instead of one.
